'''Meridian Hall''' was a gathering place located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Paladius]] addressed his [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]] in the Meridian Hall, but was interrupted by [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], who bribed a technician to detonate the gas pipes running under the Hall, creating an illusion of a [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] summoned by Kallig at a precise moment to show a strong possession of power.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Meridian Hall appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
